india.one_line: Sarvam's Chinese-model hosting sparks sovereignty debate; OpenAI and Google deepen India pushes.

themes.title: Sarvam Token Factory sparks sovereign AI debate
themes.text: Sarvam AI launched Token Factory, an OpenAI-compatible API serving eight open-weight models on Indian GPU clusters, but six are from Chinese companies despite a ₹98.68 crore government subsidy for indigenous models. The platform already processes over 450 billion DeepSeek tokens daily.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI opens Token Factory to run global open-weight models on Indian servers

themes.title: OpenAI appoints India business development lead
themes.text: OpenAI named Pragya Misra, its first India hire, to lead business development for India and South Asia, citing over 100 million weekly users in its largest market.

stories.headline: OpenAI names Pragya Misra to lead business development in India and South Asia

themes.title: Google rolls out agentic assistant in India
themes.text: Google is releasing its agentic AI assistant Tasks, powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, for free in India and five other markets, enabling calls, bookings, and purchases.

stories.headline: Google rolls out Gemini Tasks assistant for free in six markets
